verdict.rationale: GitBook advertises 'Site customization', 'Advanced branding options', and a 'block-based visual editor & custom blocks' plus custom domain support, showing some theme/branding controls (gitbook-docs-3, -11, -30, -47). However, none of the evidence explicitly confirms custom CSS/JS injection or embedding of fully custom React/UI components, and a community reviewer explicitly called landing-page customization 'limited' (gitbook-comm-3), directly cutting against a full brand-matching claim. missing for 10: explicit docs on custom CSS/JS support, custom component/embed capability, and independent confirmation that deep branding (beyond logo/colors/domain) is achievable.
